svg.title: AICC browser HTTP persona — http://
svg.desc: Lowercase Inter 640 http colon, a silver conductor wand serving as the first slash, a normal silver second slash, and a gloved conductor hand.
svg.metadata: Self-contained hybrid SVG. Inter variable font instantiated at wght=640 and converted to paths; overlapping t contours are exterior-unioned before stroking. Visible string: http://.
